name: TFG Denham Springs
old_description: Our dedicated TFG Service team is factory trained and specializes in fixing Taylor & Henny Penny equipment guaranteeing limited down time for your equipment. Call us today!
about:
TFG Denham Springs is a location of Total Foodservice Group (TFG), headquartered in Denham Springs, Louisiana. The company was founded by managing partners Blaine Martin and Butch Shelton, who brought together experts from across the foodservice industry to provide personable, masterful support to operators across the Southern United States.

TFG operates as a distributor and service provider for commercial foodservice equipment, representing brands such as Taylor, Henny Penny, Flavor Burst, Middleby, Emery Thompson, Icetro, and Purdy. The company stocks genuine OEM parts for all represented lines, offers factory-trained repair service specializing in Taylor and Henny Penny equipment, and provides complete installation, on-site training, and demo kitchen facilities. With offices in seven cities including Nashville, Metairie, Memphis, Little Rock, Flowood, Denham Springs, and Houston, TFG serves a broad regional footprint.

The company serves foodservice operators, restaurants, and commercial kitchens throughout the Southern US. Customers include dairy bars, quick-service restaurants, and institutional kitchens that rely on soft-serve machines, pressure fryers, frozen beverage systems, and batch freezers. TFG's service network aims to minimize equipment downtime through rapid response and an Auto Ship program for user-changeable parts.

TFG differentiates itself through three pillars: local availability of customer service representatives and technicians, preparedness with a focus on response time and job completion, and a team committed to continuous certification and knowledge sharing. The partners emphasize a culture of "People First, Forward Thinking, Whatever It Takes" to reduce operator stress in a fast-changing industry.
